items.title: Bill Phillips Interview, 1961-05-24
items.q: I went to Shalini. Old man Shalini, I went to him for about a year and a half or two years.

ctx.x: Well you didn't start when you were a little kid now.

No, I started when I was quite a man. In 23 I started. I mean I started to practice it. But when I got out playing music it was around about 25. Because I went to the old man Cantrell for music lessons and reading lessons. And then after I went to Shalini. Old man Shalini, I went to him for about a year and a half or two years. And the first I went to Shalini and I wound up with Mr. Cantrell. And that's when, after I was there about two years, close to three years with him, then I went to Dejune's Orchestra. I…
Yeah, but we had a band before you went with that. Oh yeah, well yeah we had the Dejohn Phillips band. And we played at the lake together. At the lake together.
